long_biography.plain_text:
Eti began as Firuz Kanatlı's biscuit factory in Eskişehir, making his son Firuzhan the second generation of an established food-manufacturing family. When the founder moved to an honorary role, Firuzhan became chairman. A 2006 reorganisation separated family oversight from daily management, creating a board with independent members and installing a professional chief executive.

Kanatlı has framed his stewardship around preserving the founder's emphasis on quality while building a broader international business. His chairmanship combines succession with active governance rather than day-to-day operations. The structure lets professional managers run the enterprise while the family board guides long-term direction, investment and continuity.
